name: Elizabeth I
role: Queen of England and Ireland from 1558 to 1603
contribution: Queen of England and Ireland from 17 November 1558 until her death in 1603.
legacy: After the short, disastrous reigns of her half-siblings, her 44 years on the throne provided welcome stability for the kingdom and helped to forge a sense of national identity.
image_credit: Attributed to William Segar / Attributed to George Gower / Formerly attributed to Nicholas Hilliard · Public domain

checks.lead: Elizabeth I (7 September 1533 – 24 March 1603) was Queen of England and Ireland from 17 November 1558 until her death in 1603. She was the last and longest reigning monarch of the House of Tudor. Her eventful reign, and its effect on history and culture, gave name to the Elizabethan era.
